dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) subtype by both the Hans algorithm

stage_i.quote: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage IA. FDG PET-CT 2026-09-03 shows a single contiguous right cervical nodal region

stage_nonbulky_no_b.quote: Disease is non-bulky (largest node 3.1 cm; bulky = >=10 cm)

stage_pet_no_marrow_biopsy.quote: NCCN does not require marrow biopsy when PET shows no marrow involvement

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: it is NOT a double-expressor by the Hans definition, since MYC immunostaining is 15% (above 10%) but BCL2 is 30% (below the 50% threshold)

prog_ipi_low.quote: IPI 0 of 5: age 45 (>=0, <=60), stage I (0), ECOG 0 (0), LDH normal (0), no extranodal sites (0)

tx_curative_rchop.quote: Decision: 4 cycles of R-CHOP 21 with primary G-CSF support and NO radiotherapy.

tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.quote: Decision: 4 cycles of R-CHOP 21 with primary G-CSF support and NO radiotherapy.
tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.note: 4 R-CHOP without RT and with PET-directed action, but omits the 2 extra rituximab doses of FLYER.

tx_no_rt_goals.quote: Omitting radiation is the option that best matches her explicit wish to avoid neck irradiation

tx_alternatives.quote: my alternative is 3 cycles R-CHOP plus 3 cycles R with ISRT 30 Gy to the right cervical field
tx_alternatives.note: Alternative is a garbled 3 R-CHOP + 3 R + ISRT rather than the standard R-CHOP x3 + ISRT.

cns_low_no_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no CNS prophylaxis, meaning no intrathecal methotrexate and no high-dose systemic methotrexate, and no routine brain MRI or CSF sampling.

resp_interim_pet.quote: Deauville 4-5 means image-guided core or excisional biopsy of the most FDG-avid lesion BEFORE changing therapy
resp_interim_pet.note: Interim PET is after cycle 2, not after cycle 4; the post-cycle-4 end-of-treatment PET does trigger biopsy/RT.

work_pregnancy_test.quote: Remaining before cycle 1: (1) a negative pregnancy test

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: so she is immune to HBV and needs neither antiviral prophylaxis nor HBV DNA monitoring

work_echo_reviewed.quote: cumulative doxorubicin 200 mg/m2 (4 cycles x 50 mg/m2) with low risk given LVEF 63%

sup_stop_coc_switch.quote: stop the combined oral contraceptive now (also contraindicated by migraine with aura); use a progestin-only or non-hormonal method

sup_coc_reason.quote: estrogen-containing contraception is contraindicated in migraine with aura (ischemic stroke risk) and it increases thromboembolic risk during chemotherapy

sup_fertility_counselling.quote: oncofertility referral with an AMH for oocyte or embryo cryopreservation

fit_goals.quote: She is fully fit for full-dose R-CHOP; no dose reduction or comorbidity-driven modification is indicated.
